David Hunterborough is an NPC located in  Tangleburg. They introduce  Hunting, keep track of  Hunting Milestones, and grant the player  David's Cloak.

Milestones

[edit | edit source]

David Hunterborough offers several Milestones for  David's Cloak. These are for:

  • Unlocking unique Attributes
  • Syphoning  Attribute Shards
  • Hunting Combat creatures
  • Hunting Water creatures
  • Hunting Forest creatures
  • Obtaining  Attribute Shards from Huntraps
  • Obtaining  Attribute Shards from Salts

Dialogue

[edit | edit source]
Condition Dialogue
Before unlocking Heart of the Forest
[NPC] David Hunterborough: <player>! Have you talked to Hina at the front of the island to get your hands on a Heart of the Forest?
Before completing Swoop's tasks
[NPC] David Hunterborough: I talked to Swoop the other day, he explained a lot of interesting Foraging Mechanics to me.
[NPC] David Hunterborough: Perhaps you should talk to him too, he’s at the entrance of the Village!
First Interaction
[NPC] David Hunterborough: Greetings!
[NPC] David Hunterborough: I'm David Hunterborough, the island's Hunting Specialist.
Select an option: [Hunting?]
Selecting [Hunting?]
[NPC] David Hunterborough: Hunting has been around for eons, perfected by advanced beings known as the Precursors.
[NPC] David Hunterborough: They discovered that within every creature lies a power unique to its kind.
Select an option: [So, how do we access it?]
Selecting [So, how do we access it?]
[NPC] David Hunterborough: Some creatures can be tamed, granting you their full power, as you may have seen with Pets.
[NPC] David Hunterborough: But most creatures cannot be tamed, so hunters extract what we call a Shard.
Select an option: [A Shard?]
Selecting [A Shard?]
[NPC] David Hunterborough: Exactly. It represents the creature's biological footprint, its core attribute.
[NPC] David Hunterborough: By using a Shard, you harness that unique power yourself.
Select an option: [Interesting. What does a Shard look like?]
Selecting [Interesting. What does a Shard look like?]
[NPC] David Hunterborough: It's better if you start hunting to find out for yourself.
[NPC] David Hunterborough: Talk to Alan and buy your first hunting weapon to get started.
Before buying a Huntaxe from Alan
[NPC] David Hunterborough: It's better if you start Hunting yourself!
[NPC] David Hunterborough: But first, you should go talk to Alan and get proper gear.
After buying a Huntaxe from Alan
[NPC] David Hunterborough: Perfect! You have your very first hunting weapon.
[NPC] David Hunterborough: That's all you need to get started on your hunting journey.
[NPC] David Hunterborough: Head over to Oden, they'll teach you the basics of hunting.
[NPC] David Hunterborough: You'll find them north of the village!
Before completing Oden's and Albert's tasks
[NPC] David Hunterborough: First you should talk to Oden, they will show you the basics of Hunting.
[NPC] David Hunterborough: Go find them North of the Village!
After buying a  Small Pocket Black Hole from Albert
[NPC] David Hunterborough: Wow!
[NPC] David Hunterborough: It only took you ##:## to complete that objective!
[NPC] David Hunterborough: [time-based message, see below]
[NPC] David Hunterborough: You got your very first Combat Shard!
[NPC] David Hunterborough: You can find all your Shards in your Hunting Box, inside your Hunting Skill Menu!
[NPC] David Hunterborough: But there are various types of monsters out there you can Hunt.
[NPC] David Hunterborough: You should go talk to Jaeger next!
[NPC] David Hunterborough: You will find them close to the Loch.
Repeats until spoken to Jaeger
[NPC] David Hunterborough: But there are various types of monsters out there you can Hunt.
[NPC] David Hunterborough: You should go talk to Jaeger next!
[NPC] David Hunterborough: You will find them close to the Loch.
After completing Jaeger's task
[NPC] David Hunterborough: You already completed your training with Jaeger?
[NPC] David Hunterborough: It only took you ##:## to complete that objective!
[NPC] David Hunterborough: [time-based message, see below]
[NPC] David Hunterborough: You got your very first Water Shard!
Select an option: [Does the type of the Shard matter?]
Selecting [Does the type of the Shard matter?]
[NPC] David Hunterborough: It does!
[NPC] David Hunterborough: But that is still too early for you to learn.
[NPC] David Hunterborough: You have to complete your training, with Auryon.
[NPC] David Hunterborough: They should be South of the Village.
Before completing Auryon's task
[NPC] David Hunterborough: You should go talk to Auryon next!
[NPC] David Hunterborough: They should be South of the Village.
After completing Auryon's task
[NPC] David Hunterborough: You managed to complete your Hunting training!
[NPC] David Hunterborough: It only took you ##:## to complete that objective!
[NPC] David Hunterborough [time-based message, see below]
[NPC] David Hunterborough: You got your very first Forest Shard!
[NPC] David Hunterborough: Combat, Water, and Forest are the only 3 types of Shards.
[NPC] David Hunterborough: Dont ask me why, I have no idea!
[NPC] David Hunterborough: Now you should finally learn what Shards are for.
[NPC] David Hunterborough: You should go talk to my assistant.
[NPC] David Hunterborough: No, not Pounce, my other assistant Kysha, right next to the Fusion Machine in the back.
Before completing Kysha's task
[NPC] David Hunterborough: You should go talk to my assistant Kysha, right next to the Fusion Machine in the back.
After completing Kysha's task
[NPC] David Hunterborough: You've mastered the fundamentals of hunting!
[NPC] David Hunterborough: At first, the attributes may seem weak, but over time they will grow stronger.
[NPC] David Hunterborough: The more you syphon an attribute, the more powerful it becomes.
[NPC] David Hunterborough: Hunters continue to discover new Shards every year.
[NPC] David Hunterborough: Actually, I've got another gift for you...
[NPC] David Hunterborough: I guess I'm in a generous mood today.
After receiving  David's Cloak
[NPC] David Hunterborough: I crafted this Cloak some time ago. It seems to grow stronger with every hunt.
[NPC] David Hunterborough: Use it to take your hunting skills to the next level!
[NPC] David Hunterborough: Talk to me if you want to learn more about hunting or view your progress.
Time-based objective messages
[NPC] David Hunterborough: Very impressive!
[NPC] David Hunterborough: I've seen worse!
[NPC] David Hunterborough: You tried your best I guess!
Clicking the  Hunting Toolkit nearby
[NPC] David Hunterborough: Ah, the Hunting Toolkit!
[NPC] David Hunterborough: An absolutely essential hunting item! It allows you to rapidly swap between your hunting tools!
[NPC] David Hunterborough: You should buy one sometime!

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
  • David Hunterborough is likely a reference to the British broadcaster and biologist David Attenborough, best known for his nature documentaries.
